jsonld.description: Social media creative planning, design and short video for D2C, B2B and education brands.

acceptedAnswer.text: Social media creatives are the posts, carousels, stories and short videos that a brand publishes, planned around a few themes and designed in one consistent style.

mainEntity.name: How does social media creative work with MMC?

acceptedAnswer.text: We set pillars and a design style, produce on a rhythm your team can sustain, and read what earns attention so the best content can also run as paid creative.

mainEntity.name: What does social media creative cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: A monthly scope, agreed after a call. It is written down so you can see what each month covers. We do not publish a price list, because the right scope depends on your site, your market and how much you want done.
No. We cannot guarantee reach, followers or sales. We commit to well-made, consistent creative tied to a goal, and honest reporting.

mainEntity.name: Who is social media creative for?

acceptedAnswer.text: Brands that want a consistent presence tied to results. Not only D2C. We work with D2C, B2B and education brands, and set the work up differently for each: D2C on creative that feeds ads, B2B on credibility and thought leadership, education on campus life and admissions moments.

mainEntity.name: What do you need from us?

acceptedAnswer.text: Brand assets, product or service details, access to your social accounts, and a named person who can approve posts.

hub.sub: Content pillars, designed posts and short video, planned on a rhythm and built to work alongside your paid media.

answer.label: In short
answer.lead: Social media creative is the work of planning and producing the posts, carousels and short videos that keep a brand visible and consistent where its audience spends time. MMC produces it for D2C, B2B and education brands, set around a few content pillars and one design style, on a rhythm your team can sustain.

leaks.note: Screens are illustrative recreations of each platform's interface, not client data. Platform names and logos belong to their owners.
leaks.lede: Social works when it is planned and consistent. Each stage below is where feeds lose people, and how we run it.

stages.why: A feed with no themes gives followers no reason to expect anything from you.
stages.does: We define a few content pillars tied to what your audience cares about, and plan a calendar around them.

stages.breaks: Posts that look different every time.
stages.why: Consistency is what makes a brand recognisable in a fast scroll.
stages.does: We design posts, carousels and templates in one visual style that is recognisably yours.

stages.why: Short vertical video is a large part of what people watch, and it gives a brand a human face.
stages.does: We plan and produce short vertical videos, from scripts to edits, for the formats each platform favours.

stages.breaks: Bursts of posting followed by silence.
stages.why: Irregular posting makes a brand feel inactive and weakens the habit of following you.
stages.does: We plan a realistic publishing rhythm that your team and ours can sustain.

stages.why: Likes do not show whether social supports the business. Reach, saves, clicks and enquiries say more.
stages.does: We review what earns attention and action, and use it to shape the next round, including which posts to turn into ads.
